data.description: Live in a thriving community dedicated to redefining the luxury seaside lifestyle.

data.answer:
Named after His Highness Sheikh Rashid Bin Saeed Al Maktoum, Mina Rashid opened in 1972 as Dubai's first commercial port, managing general cargo, roll-on, roll-off ferries, and passenger vessels. However, as the Mina Rashid port evolved, cargo operations eventually shifted to Jebel Ali Port.

In early 2016, H.H. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum announced the transition of Port Rashid UAE. Subsequently, a detailed scale model of the envisioned development was unveiled to the press and public at the DP World booth during the Dubai International Boat Show.

Emaar embarked on a mission to uphold this historic landmark while introducing luxury coastal living. With a staggering AED 25 billion investment, the master developers aim to revitalize the rich coastal heritage by establishing a floating yacht club, a signature hotel, a shopping mall, and other recreational amenities. Mina Rashid Marina, or Port Rashid Marina, is home to several of the world’s longest superyachts.

Through the collaboration between Emaar and DP World-owned P&O Marinas, the joint venture enhances cruise tourism and offers residents a contemporary lifestyle. Spanning across 6.8 million square feet, the under-development area will be divided into seven districts.

Mina Rashid features apartment complexes with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom waterfront apartments, as well as a few 4-bedroom units. Some of the high points of the properties in the area are the spacious balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows offering breathtaking views of the marina and the yachts. Residents can also enjoy Iconic Burj Khalifa and Arabian Sea views from their residences. 

Off Plan Properties in Mina Rashid

There are various properties in Rashid Yachts & Marina for sale, ready to enhance the beauty of the area. Sunridge at Rashid Yachts and Marina is a project featuring meticulously finished 1- and 2-bedroom apartments. Adjacent to Dubai’s longest water canal, the tranquil residence will offer breathtaking views. Another upcoming project in the Mina Rashid community is Seascape. Developed by Emaar Properties, the complex features 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, townhouses with private sandy beaches, and a marina.

Similarly, Seashore is a joint venture between Emaar Properties and DP World, presenting impeccably designed 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments. Residents can easily access nearby attractions such as the Dubai Museum, Al Raffa, Dubai Maritime City, Etihad Museum, and various beaches. Another exquisite residential development in the community is Seagate. Comprising four buildings offering stunning 1 to 4-bedroom apartments that boast captivating views of the marina and serene waters.

Home buyers and investors are also eagerly waiting for the Emaar Ocean Point project to be completed. A handpicked selection of elegant 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and luxurious 3-bedroom townhouses are meticulously designed to offer residents a tranquil escape amidst the vibrancy city.

Experience the epitome of waterfront living at Emaar Bayline & Avonlea. This development features luxury 1, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom duplexes. Moreover, Sirdhana at Mina Rashid by Emaar Properties is a four-building complex offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses.

Furthermore, Emaar's latest residential project, Ocean Star, perfectly combines the charm of living by the water at Rashid Yachts & Marina. Offering a variety of homes, Ocean Star appeals to a wide range of preferences. Prospective homeowners have the option to choose from 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, guaranteeing an unmatched standard of luxury and comfort.

Properties for Sale in Mina Rashid

In Mina Rashid, 1-bedroom apartments are available for sale, ranging from AED 1.1M to AED 1.8M. You can buy 2-bedroom apartments for prices between AED 1.6M and AED 3.1M. For 3-bedroom apartments, expect to pay between AED 3M and AED 5.9M. Additionally, there are a few spacious 4-bedroom apartments available, priced from AED 5M to AED 10M. You can contact Provident agents to find out about the availability to properties for rent in Mina Rashid.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Mina Rashid?

data.answer:
Life in Mina Rashid is a harmonious blend of coastal tranquillity, modern luxury, and vibrant community living. Residents enjoy the serene coastal lifestyle in Mina Rashid, which has stunning views of the marina. They can easily access leisure activities like beach strolls, water sports, and yacht outings.

Mina Rashid fosters a close-knit community atmosphere, where neighbors come together to enjoy social gatherings, cultural events, and the camaraderie of seaside living, making it a coveted destination for locals and expatriates seeking a vibrant yet tranquil residential experience.

Public Transportation in Mina Rashid

The Mina Rashid location is easily accessible by bus. Al Ghubaiba bus stop, Dubai Dry Docks bus stop, and Caltex Reservoir bus stop are all 15- to 20-minute from the community. Furthermore, residents can take the Dubai water taxi service, a tourist-oriented transportation option that facilitates ferry and water taxi services between the cruise terminal and Al Ghubaiba station to reach the destination.

Supermarkets in Mina Rashid

Currently, supermarket options are limited in the area. Nonetheless, residents can easily access Spinneys in Al Mankhool and Carrefour in the City Centre of Al Shindaghal, both situated within a 15-minute drive. With development work moving forward at full speed, you can expect lots of convenient stores and other facilities to be open in the area soon. Other nearby supermarkets near Mina Rashid, Dubai, include Al Madina Supermarket, Malabar Supermarket, and Al Baraha Minimart.

Shopping Malls Near Marina Rashid

A nearby shopping mall, City Centre Al Shindagha, provides a diverse range of retail options, dining venues, and entertainment choices, serving the needs of residents in the vicinity. Also situated within a convenient distance, Mercato Shopping Mall offers a unique Italian-themed shopping experience with a selection of fashion boutiques, cafes, restaurants, and entertainment options. A waterfront retail, dining, and leisure destination is expected to be built in the Mina Rashid area.

Hotels in Mina Rashid Location

The Queen Elizabeth 2 (QE2) in Mina Rashid is the only floating hotel in the emirate. Its guest rooms and suites boast portholes and expansive windows offering stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and the Dubai skyline. Within QE2, guests can indulge in authentic British cuisine at its casual and fine dining restaurants, while the onboard bar offers a wide array of wines and snacks.

Beyond accommodation and dining, QE2 also serves as a venue for corporate events, public meetings, and wedding functions. Its various event spaces, adorned with 1960s-inspired interiors, can accommodate gatherings ranging from 10 to 1000 guests with exemplary hospitality. Additionally, the hotel terminal houses a museum exhibiting original art and literature from the 1960s, adding to its allure as one of the emirate's notable landmarks and popular tourist destinations.

Schools in Mina Rashid Dubai

For families with school-aged children, several reputable schools near Mina Rashid offer high-quality education. Ambassador School, Hessa Bint Al Mer Private School, and Al Maktoum Primary School are among them. Additionally, GEMS Winchester School, situated on Oud Metha Road, operates from Foundation Stage 2 to Year 12 and is recognized as one of the top GEMS British curriculum schools in Dubai. With over 3,800 students from diverse backgrounds, it is located just a 17-minute drive away from the community.

Individuals seeking higher education opportunities can explore Al Wasl University, European University College, and Mohammed Bin Rashid University of Medicine and Health Sciences. These universities near Mina Rashid are all within a convenient 20-minute drive from the neighborhood.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in Mina Rashid

Numerous mosques in close proximity to Mina Rashid are situated on the southern side of the community, such as Bin Zayed Mosque, Masjid Hareb Bin Hareb, and Ali Ibn Abi Talib Mosque. Muslim community members can reach these mosques within a 15 to 17-minute drive. The Grand Bur Dubai Mosque, which can accommodate up to 1,200 worshippers at a time, is also near Mina Rashid, Dubai.

Some of Dubai's prominent churches are located in the neighboring community of Umm Hurair 2, including St. Mary’s Catholic Church, Holy Trinity Church, and Maranatha Full Gospel Church. It takes approximately 17 to 20 minutes by car to reach these churches near Mina Rashid. Hindu residents have access to temples in Bur Dubai, reachable within a 15-minute drive. Among them are Shiva Temple, Shirdi Sai Baba Mandir, and Shree Krishna Haveli.

Clinics and Hospitals in Mina Rashid

Residents seeking immediate healthcare assistance can visit hospitals in Dubai Healthcare City. Within the neighboring community of Mina Rashid, Dubai, several renowned medical facilities are available. These include the American Academy of Cosmetic Surgery Hospital, Dubai Dental Hospital, and Moorfields Eye Hospital. Additionally, nearby hospitals such as International Modern Hospital, Aster Hospital, and Rashid Hospital are reachable within a 20 to 22-minute drive.

Mina Rashid Location & Nearby Areas

Mina Rashid is conveniently situated close to several well-known areas of Dubai. Deira is located to the southeast of the community, while Bur Dubai lies to the south. Additionally, Al Mina Dubai, another residential area, is nearby and situated along the Dubai coastline. Furthermore, the maritime hub of Dubai Maritime City is situated to the west of the community.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Mina Rashid

data.answer:
Home to stunning Rashid Yachts and Marina capable of accommodating 430 wet berths for yachts up to 100m long, the district will feature six interconnected district parks for leisure and recreation. It will also house a rejuvenating Central Canal Pool designed for the exclusive use of future residents. Many other activities are planned for the discerning homeowners of the community.

Mina Rashid Restaurants and Bars: 

Numerous Port Rashid restaurants offer a diverse selection of cuisines, including international, Indian, Mediterranean, and traditional Arabian dishes. Tapa King, Silver Spoon Restaurant, and Al Safrah Restaurant are among them. Some of Dubai's finest dining venues are also located near Mina Rashid. Notably, Nusr-Et Steakhouse, founded by Nusret Gökçe, famously known as Salt Bae, specializes in Turkish cuisine, featuring marinated tenderloin, tuna tartar, shashlik, and the renowned Turkish dessert baklava. This restaurant is situated just an 18-minute drive away from Mina Rashid. Other nearby dining options include Gaia, Coya, and Mint Leaf of London.

Beaches Near Mina Rashid by Emaar:

The waterfront enclave of Mina Rashid will boast a beach spanning 135,625 square feet, equivalent to the size of 2.5 football fields. Alongside, attractions such as the floating yacht club, Venetian piazza, and private beach club will further enhance the beach experience. Residents will also have the opportunity to unwind under the sun at some of Dubai's premier beaches, including Jumeirah Public Beach, North Beach, and La Mer Beach, all conveniently located within a 15-minute drive from Mina Rashid, Dubai.

Attractions and Landmarks in Mina Rashid

Rashid Yachts and Marina boasts several attractions and landmarks that contribute to its allure:

Queen Elizabeth 2 (QE2): A monumental landmark, QE2 is an iconic ocean liner that has been transformed into a floating hotel. This historic vessel offers a unique hospitality experience with its luxurious accommodations, dining options, and entertainment facilities.

Al Shindagha Museum: Located nearby, Al Shindagha Museum is a cultural destination that showcases the rich heritage and history of Dubai. Visitors can explore exhibits, artifacts, and interactive displays that highlight various aspects of Emirati culture, traditions, and maritime history.

These attractions add to the charm and appeal of Rashid Yachts and Marina, offering residents and visitors alike a glimpse into Dubai's past and present while providing unique experiences and opportunities for exploration.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Despite being a waterfront community offering various water sports activities, Mina Rashid also provides open-air green spaces for residents to enjoy leisurely strolls or jogs. The project boasts six interconnected district parks and boardwalks, promoting a healthy lifestyle.

For fitness enthusiasts, the community podium houses a gym where residents can maintain their workout routines. Additionally, nearby gyms such as Fitness Extreme Muscle Factory, Al Thani Fitness Centre, and Lion’s Gym are accessible within a 15-minute drive from Mina Rashid, Dubai.

For ladies seeking beauty treatments, some of the finest salons in Dubai are just a short drive away from the community. These include Sisters Beauty Lounge, Eyana Ladies Salon, and NStyle Beauty Lounge. Notably, Sisters Beauty Lounge in The Village Mall offers various treatments, including hair perming, lash lifting, manicures, and pedicures.

As Mina Rashid continues to develop and expand, residents may experience construction noise and disruptions from nearby construction projects, which could impact quality of life, especially during the early stages of development.

more_info.question: FAQs About Mina Rashid by Emaar

data.answer:
Is parking readily available in Mina Rashid?

Parking in the area poses no inconvenience, as most apartment complexes provide designated parking areas. Residents are assigned a parking spot on either the basement or podium level corresponding to their apartment type. Visitors can park their vehicles on the street.

Who is Rashid Yachts & Marina owner? 

Rashid Yachts and Marina is an exceptional community designed by Emaar Properties. 

What is Rashid Yachts and Marina location?

Rashid Yachts & Marina is a district situated within Mina Rashid port in the Bur Dubai area of Dubai.

How to reach Port Rashid UAE?

The port is accessible via Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Street (E11) or Al Khaleej Road (D85), depending on your direction of travel. If you arrive in Dubai via cruise ship, your cruise line may provide shuttle services or organized transfers to Port Rashid. Be sure to check with your cruise line for specific details and arrangements.

What are the attractions near Mina Rashid?

Nearby attractions to Mina Rashid include historical sites such as Al Fahidi Fort and the Dubai Museum, as well as modern landmarks like the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. Additionally, the vibrant neighborhoods of Bur Dubai and Deira offer shopping, dining, and entertainment options within easy reach.

What amenities are available in Mina Rashid?

Mina Rashid offers a wide array of amenities, including residential buildings, hotels, restaurants, retail outlets, parks, waterfront promenades, and recreational facilities. It is also home to the historic Queen Elizabeth 2 (QE2) ocean liner, which has been transformed into a floating hotel.

What types of properties are available in Mina Rashid?

Mina Rashid offers luxury apartments and waterfront residences.

What makes Mina Rashid a unique residential choice?

Its prime waterfront location, stunning marina views, and blend of modern amenities with historical charm.

How is the transportation connectivity in Mina Rashid?

Excellent, with easy access to major roads, public transport, and proximity to Dubai International Airport.

Is Mina Rashid a pet-friendly community?

Yes, Mina Rashid is a pet-friendly community with ample outdoor spaces for pets.
